You stop charging, plant both hands in the ground, and let the earth answer.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
Self; each enemy within 2 squares.
Duration
Immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene.
Type
Signature
Weak
2 physical damage, and push 1 square directly away from you.
Standard
4 physical damage, push 2 squares, and it is Prone.
Strong
6 physical damage, push 3 squares, and it is Prone and Dazed 1. Structures and unattended objects in the area take double damage. Resolve collisions normally. This does not move you.
